entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-20
entry.content:
Issues

  • After installing VS2026 all Builds fail with CSC : error CS2016: Code page '1252' is invalid or not installed #81381
  • Add `Type` in `IRangeVariableSymbol` #81379

  • "Create and assign field" refactoring produces invalid code with primary constructors #81374
  • Add Exception Handling Robustness Analysis Rules to Roslyn #81371
  • Document.GetOptionsAsync returns wrong TabSize for VB document #81369
  • Area - Convert for/foreach/linq #81367
  • Target-typed expressions with nested elements/branches don't get converted when one of nested expressions is directly an error #81365
    Backlog
  • Visual Studio2026 the tooltip is missing on hover #81357
  • C# 14 extension members: generic inference fails where classic extension methods succeed #81356
    18.3
